additional_info.subject: RE: ID0448047-DC/Si-D/DK-[Multiple]Firmware update CRM:02681000769
additional_info.body:
Dear Rasmus,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0448047.
The ticket was opened for issues to rollout and update fw 7.0.5.
I checked via SSH chargers
SMtkLJ, I9vpqq
and
aifwN5
, and the Hawkbit.conf file was missing on all three chargers. I uploaded the correct Hawkbit.conf file, and the rollout has been automatically completed for all three chargers.
You can proceed with the FW update to v7.0.5 at you earliest convienence.
Since the issue is solved and there is no further action pending for this ticket, I will proceed to close the ticket.
With kind regards,
